Despite playing League for well over 2 years I just learned stutter stepping (yes I know, I'm very bad) and I would love some tips on how to master this quickly. Any and all tips are welcomed, and thank you in advanced
Any Tips for mastering Stutter Stepping (aka animation canceling)

The biggest problem League of legends players have is that they are never willing to break their comfort zone. Just keep forcing yourself to do it and don't let yourself get into lazy habits. Also try using attack move as much as possible (a key).

The best advice I can give ya is to go into a custom game with your favorite champion to CS with and learn the attack animation.

Try queueing an attack and move as soon as you feel the attack has fired, if it doesn't fire, then wait a little longer. Test the limits, and practice practice practice.

I had been playing for a couple of years until I truly understood stutter stepping. I learned it with Irelia, who to play correctly you must have her attack animation on lock, and yes, it took me many many games to learn.

When you grasp this, start focusing on where you SHOULD move after each attack. The real advantage of stutter stepping isn't just being efficient with your damage, but positioning in fights and in lane.

Good luck!
